### The University of Jordan

#### Description of Courses

| Course Title | Course Number | Credits |
|--------------|---------------|---------|
| النظريات الفقهية (Theoretical Jurisprudence) | 0406901 | 3 |
| **Description:** This course introduces the theory of jurisprudence, its definitions, concepts, and the relationship between its branches. It discusses the rules and principles as well as the scholarly critiques related to the field. It also emphasizes the application of these theories to real-life cases. |
| قراءات في الفكر الإسلامي وتطبيقاته المعاصرة (Readings in Islamic Thought and Its Contemporary Applications) | 0406902 | 3 |
| **Description:** This course covers the various theories of fundamental jurisprudence and legal reasoning, including the sources of law. It focuses on doctrinal standards and applications in modern legal matters. |
| الشاملية الأصولية في التعاملات والترجيح (Fundamental Comprehensiveness in Transactions and Preference) | 0406903 | 3 |
| **Description:** This course aims to develop advanced skills for analyzing, discussing, and judging various legal issues, emphasizing the ability to extract and prioritize legal rulings. |
